Kotlin is preserved but inactive.

## Constraints & Preferences
- **Expo/React Native is the ACTIVE Phase 1 production app** — `expo/` is active, `backend/` is active production backend
- **Kotlin `android-ivx-holdings/` is PRESERVED but INACTIVE** — do not fix, build, or modify Kotlin now
- Mixed feed pattern: 3 Regular Investment Cards → 1 Reel Card → repeat
- `display_type` field (`investment_card` | `reel`) drives card routing, not media inference
- APK filename format: `ivx-holdings-v<version>-build<versionCode>-final.apk`
- APK must be built from `expo/`, not `android-ivx-holdings/`
- Owner-only autonomous endpoints require `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN` bearer authentication
- **Autonomous must be END-TO-END LIVE** — no partial/plan-only accepted; engines must produce real discovered/saved counts
- SEC EDGAR Form D filings are the legal data source for buyer/investor/JV discovery (public federal records)

## Key Decisions
- Expo is the sole Phase 1 production app — Kotlin explicitly excluded from all current builds
- Debug keystore used for release signing (no production keystore available in sandbox)
- `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN` env var added to Render for service-to-service owner authentication
- New GitHub token `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` replaces expired `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`
- Render deploy body format: `{"clearCache": "do_not_clear"}` (string, not boolean)
- Owner email allowlist: `IVX_OWNER_REGISTRATION_EMAILS=owner@ivxholding.com`, baseline `iperez4242@gmail.com`
- **Lowered buyer min-offering floor from $1M to $100K** — $1M floor rejected 99.9% of real-estate Form D filings (1 in 800 passed), and after first run that 1 filing was already in pipeline → 0 saved every subsequent run
- **Broadened investor/JV queries** — narrow queries like "private equity real estate" returned only 6 total EDGAR filings; after 35+ runs all were seen → 0 saved. Broadened to "real estate", "real estate fund", "real estate holdings", etc. (10,000+ filings each)
- **Removed date-range filter from EDGAR search** — narrow queries had filings only in older years; 2024+ filter excluded them entirely. Keep date-descending sort for freshness
- **Increased maxPages from 8 to 30** (800→3,000 hits) so engines can page past already-seen filings
- **Cherry-pick workaround for GitHub push** — `.rork/history` contains token, so push from temp branch `deploy-fix`/`deploy-fix2` to GitHub main
